content: Written 2026-10-07 21:13. Real row 4 S3cb + RE + RE2 = code 3582aed, stage B from v7's A: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --render-evidence --band-evidence --dataset real --resume --sessions ab. Started right after RE's B eval, not chosen by RE's score (supervisor 21:13: the form rests on KinectFusion Eq. 9 + the GT-free diagnosis).

KinectFusion (Newcombe et al., ISMAR 2011, sec. 3.3; original checked) Eq. 9: 'Psi(eta) = min(1, eta/mu) sgn(eta) iff eta >= -mu, null otherwise' -- a reading writes 'inside' (negative SDF) up to mu behind the measured surface and nothing beyond; online, per frame. In the layer's element rule (hit resets, -ln p_miss per 'not a surface' observation, retire above ln 99) a reading within mu in front of the element (delta in [-mu, -(tol + extent))) is one such observation; beyond mu no evidence.
mu = the layer's truncation 0.15 m (LayerConfig.truncation, the TSDF runs' active-window truncation), tol + extent as the element rule's on band; no new constant.

GT-free diagnosis on the S3cb B map (analysis/behind_hidden_s3cb.json): of the first-echo Gaussians of A-view pixels 5-15 cm behind a B reading, 56.8 % had a hit (median 2) and 59.6 % had most blocked readings beyond the band, so the fork's session hidden vote ends 14.3 %. Offline replay of the band evidence on the S3cb B map: analysis/band_replay_s3cb.json (first start 21:12 crashed on a device mismatch in the script; restarted 21:1x).

As in TSDF fusion, a real surface lying within mu behind another measured surface along the readings (e.g. a wall within 15 cm behind a thin object seen only from the front in B) is ended too: the same behaviour as the TSDF's truncation band. To be read in the replay (B keyframes explained with / without the band's ends) and in present kept / unobserved retention.

Reading the replay: TSDF erosion inside the band is a weighted average (Eq. 11-12; the sign flips only after observations of the same order as the old weight; Eq. 13 caps the weight for dynamic scenes), while the layer's test is sequential with hit reset (ended after enough consecutive 'not a surface' observations without a hit). So the band's ends are reported by support: last support stamp in B or before, never supported, opacity -- whether they are long-supported walls rather than weakly supported floaters is written here when the replay is read.

Offline replay on the S3cb B map (analysis/band_replay_s3cb.json): element-rule ends 391 with the centre evidence alone, 182,654 with the band evidence; the 182,263 extra are all background, 150,884 older than B, 103,673 last supported in B, none never supported, opacity q10/50/90 0.79/0.999/1.0; B keyframes explained 89.84 -> 89.53 % without them; A-view first echoes on them 1.92 %. They are not weakly supported floaters but opaque, mostly B-supported Gaussians: most likely the thickness layers of 3DGS surfaces (layers 5-15 cm behind the front layer of the same wall) plus A's walls behind B's. The sequential test with hit reset ends more than the TSDF's weighted average would; expected cost: unobserved retention / present kept lower.

(a) Within a round the eligibility is updated after every frame (a hit or see-through in an earlier frame of the round removes the element from the band evidence of later frames), as the fork counts hit/through over all frames seen. (b) Known difference to the fork: session_refusion.cpp:1272 requires 2 * blocked_band > blocked over all blocked readings; the online form counts the in-band readings only and ignores the out-of-band ones (KinectFusion Eq. 9: null beyond mu), so an element blocked mostly by far occluders ends here after enough in-band rounds without a hit, while the fork would keep it. (c) 'Thickness layers' of 3DGS surfaces is a hypothesis, not a measured fact; GT-free test: for each band-ended element, along the B ray where it read inside the band, is there a surviving element within tol of the reading (the front surface the map still has).

analysis/band_replay_s3cb.json (0ac6035 form, before the per-frame eligibility update): band ends 140,906 (122,754 older than B; 65,056 last supported in B; none never supported; opacity q10/50/90 0.82/0.999/1.0); B keyframes explained 89.84 -> 89.77 %; A-view first echoes on them 0.83 %. Earlier form (no eligibility, analysis/band_replay_s3cb_v1.json): 182,263, 89.53 %, 1.92 %.
